title: What Is a Pre-Ticket for Machu Picchu?
excerpt: The Machu Picchu pre-ticket is a temporary reservation or waiting pass given to travelers before purchasing the official entrance ticket. It helps organize visitor demand in Aguas Calientes, especially during high season when daily ticket availability is limited. It is NOT the final entrance ticket. You still need to complete the purchase process. Availability depends on the remaining daily ticket spaces. View Machu Picchu Package

content_html:
Important Information

Bring your original passport
Arrive early during high season
Some circuits may sell out quickly
Availability changes every day

Where Can You Get It?

Travelers usually obtain the pre-ticket in Aguas Calientes before completing the final purchase of the official ticket to Machu Picchu.

Important Tip

If your travel schedule is tight or you are visiting Cusco during high season:

booking your tickets in advance is usually the safest option.
